title: ESPaDOnS an echelle spectropolarimetric device for stellar observations
what_was_studied: Spectropolarimetric design, modes and early operation
numerical_result: The instrument covers about 370 to 1050 nm at resolving power near 65000 in its principal mode
remaining_question: General spectroscopy and spectropolarimetry do not imply stabilized precision-RV performance

title: Search for hot Jupiters around young stars with ESPaDOnS
what_was_studied: Differential RV extraction from a young-star observing campaign
numerical_result: Run-dependent residuals of about 10 and 15 m/s were reported
remaining_question: How much of the residual is instrument drift versus activity filtering?

title: News from the CFHT ESPaDOnS spectropolarimeter
what_was_studied: Nightly drift, signal-to-noise scheduling, OPERA development and operations
numerical_result: Nightly RV drift was identified as an operational analysis topic
remaining_question: The effects of pipeline and enclosure changes need dated comparison data

title: Libre-ESpRIT reduction documentation
what_was_studied: Extraction, wavelength calibration, polarization products and stated omissions
numerical_result: One reduced spectrum contains about 190000 samples at 1.8 km/s sampling; typical calibration-fit accuracy is below 0.2 km/s
remaining_question: The pipeline does not co-add exposures or provide science-analysis tools

title: ESPaDOnS instrument page
what_was_studied: Current instrument documentation and operational caveats
numerical_result: CFHT documents queue use, processed products and continuum-polarization limitations
remaining_question: A dated semester roster is still needed for a closed current-status assertion
